pr_title: [BugFix] fix hang in async scheduling while open ENPU
source_quote:
The only sync we need when `mode=FULL` is the one between two steps, i.e., after the draft model and before the next target model.
> We don't need any sync in between the target model and draft model, or between different steps of spec, anymore.

rule.description: 在 speculative decoding 的异步调度中，`mode=FULL` 下仅需要在两个 step 之间（draft model 完成后、下一个 target model 开始前）进行 stream 同步。target model 和 draft model 之间、以及 spec 不同步骤之间的同步是不必要的，会导致性能下降甚至 hang。

antipattern.context:
The only sync we need when `mode=FULL` is the one between two steps, i.e., after the draft model and before the next target model.
> We don't need any sync in between the target model and draft model,

pattern.code:
# commit 8e86190 "Remove unnecessary conditions when using
# stream synchronization" (+5/-8)
# mode=FULL 时仅保留步骤间必要的同步

    def _sync_for_spec_decode(self, mode, step_type):
        """Synchronize NPU stream for speculative decoding."""
        if mode == FULL:
            # 仅在两个 step 之间同步：draft model 完成后、下一个 target model 之前
            if step_type == "after_draft":
                torch.npu.current_stream().synchronize()
            # 移除了 after_target 和 between_spec_steps 的不必要同步

    def _replay_graph(self, graph, mode):
        """Replay a captured ACL graph."""
        if mode == FULL:
            # 仅保留必要的步骤间同步
            graph.replay()
            torch.npu.current_stream().synchronize()
        return graph
